evidence.text:
桓宣武既廢太宰父子仍上表曰應割近情以存逺
計若除太宰父子可無後憂簡文手荅表曰所不忍
言況過於言宣武又重表辭轉苦切簡文更荅曰若

judgment.explanation: 謝 in the main text refers to 謝安 by surname. The text says 謝都無言 (Xie remained silent), and 謝安 was called into the room along with 王坦之. The candidate 謝安 matches this referent.

王 in the main text refers to 王坦之 by surname. The text says 王直擲還云多 (Wang threw the document back saying 'too many'), and 王坦之 was called into the room along with 謝安. Candidate c0 (王恭) is contradicted. Both c1 and c2 are 王坦之 from prior candidate knowledge; c1 is preferred.
謝安 is the full name appearing in the main text as one of the two people called into the room by 桓宣武. The candidate 謝安 matches directly.

温 in the Liu annotation refers to 桓温 (Huan Wen), who deeply valued 超 (Xi Chao). The annotation discusses 桓温's relationship with 郗超, consistent with the main text about 桓宣武 (桓溫). Candidate c0 (桓溫) is supported. Candidate c1 (温嶠) is contradicted as the annotation context is about 桓溫 and 郗超.

The annotation text '結温亦深相器重故潜謀密計莫不預焉/陽秋曰超謂温雄武當樂推之運遂深自委' refers to 超 as the person 郗超, who is deeply valued by 温 (桓温). The candidate c0 is 超, matching the abbreviated reference to 郗超 in the annotation. The annotation explicitly discusses 超's relationship with 温, consistent with 郗超 being the referent.

assertions.interpretation: The night after the list of court officials to be removed was finalized, Huan Xuanwu and Xi Chao lodged together in the same room.
The next morning they rose, marking the immediate continuation of the scene from the previous night.
Prior to the night scene, the list (條牒) of court officials to be removed had already been finalized by Huan Xuanwu and Xi Chao.
At the time Xie An and Wang Tanzhi were summoned in the morning, Xi Chao was still inside the bed-curtain, indicating he had not yet left from the night's lodging.
Liu annotation states that Xi Chao participated in all of Huan Wen's secret plans and confidential schemes, providing background on their ongoing relationship.
